title: AdjustmentService (F-009)
scope: AdjustmentService.save_adjustment: validate stock_date<=entry_date (AC-035), assert design exists+active, assert design has active grade mappings else raise ERR-012 (AC-040), per line: snapshot software_cb via stock.closing_balance(stock_date), compute difference, persist line, call stock.apply_adjustment(delta=difference), commit.

success_criteria.manual: Save an adjustment; difference computed correctly per line; ledger delta = difference.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: save_adjustment writes software_cb snapshot AND difference; calls apply_adjustment with delta=difference.
